ayahs.1: Aasmaanon aur zameen mein jo hai (sab) Allah ki tasbeeh kar rahe hain, woh zabardast ba-hikmat hai.
ayahs.2: Aasmaanon aur zameen ki baadshahat isi ki hai, wohi zindagi deta hai aur maut bhi aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.3: Wohi pehle hai aur wohi peechhe, wohi zaahir hai aur wohi makhfi, aur woh har cheez ko bakhoobi jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.4: Wohi hai jis ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko chhe din mein paida kiya phir arsh par mustawi ho gaya. Woh (khoob) jaanta hai us cheez ko jo zameen mein jaaye aur jo us se nikle aur jo aasmaan se neeche aaye aur jo kuch chadh kar us mein jaaye, aur jahaan kahin tum ho woh tumhare saath hai aur jo tum kar rahe ho Allah dekh raha hai.
ayahs.5: Aasmaanon ki aur zameen ki baadshahi isi ki hai. Aur tamaam kaam isi ki taraf lautaye jaate hain.
ayahs.6: Wohi raat ko din mein le jaata hai aur wohi din ko raat mein daakhil kar deta hai aur seenon ke bhedon ka woh poora aalim hai.
ayahs.7: Allah par aur us ke Rasool par imaan le aao aur us maal mein se kharch karo jis mein Allah ne tumhein (doosron ka) jaanasheen banaaya hai pas tum mein se jo imaan laayen aur khairaat karen unhein bahut bada sawaab milega.
ayahs.8: Tum Allah par imaan kyun nahi laate? Haalanke khud Rasool tumhein apne Rabb par imaan laane ki daawat de raha hai aur agar tum momin ho to woh to tum se mazboot ahd-o-paimaan bhi le chuka hai.
ayahs.9: Woh (Allah) hi hai jo apne bande par waazeh aayatein utaarta hai taake woh tumhein andheron se noor ki taraf le jaaye yaqeenan Allah Taala tum par narmi karne wala reham karne wala hai.
ayahs.10: Tumhein kya ho gaya hai jo tum Allah ki raah mein kharch nahi karte? Darasal aasmaanon aur zameenon ki meeras ka maalik (tanha) Allah hi hai tum mein se jin logon ne fatah se pehle fi-sabeelillah diya hai aur qitaal kiya hai woh (doosron ke) baraabar nahi, balke un se bahut bade darje ke hain jinhon ne fatah ke baad khairatein dein aur jihaad kiye. Haan bhalaai ka waada to Allah Taala ka un sab se hai jo kuch tum kar rahe ho us se Allah khabardaar hai.
ayahs.11: Kaun hai jo Allah Taala ko achhi tarah qarz de phir Allah Taala ise us ke liye badhaata chala jaaye aur us ke liye pasandeeda ajr saabit ho jaaye.
ayahs.12: (Qayamat ke din) tu dekhega ke momin mardon aur auraton ka noor un ke aage aage aur un ke daayen daud raha hoga aaj tumhein un jannaton ki khush-khabri hai jin ke neeche nehrein jaari hain jin mein hamesha ki rihaish hai. Yeh hai badi kaamyaabi.
ayahs.13: Us din munaafiq mard-o-aurat imaan walon se kahenge ke hamara intezaar to karo ke hum bhi tumhare noor se kuch roshni haasil kar len. Jawaab diya jaayega ke tum apne peechhe laut jaao aur roshni talaash karo. Phir un ke aur un ke darmiyaan ek deewaar haail kar di jaayegi jis mein darwaaza bhi hoga. Us ke andarooni hissa mein to rehmat hogi aur baahar ki taraf azaab hoga.
ayahs.14: Yeh chilla chilla kar un se kahenge ke kya hum tumhare saath na the woh kahenge ke haan the to sahi lekin tum ne apne aap ko fitna mein phansa rakha tha aur intezaar mein hi rahe aur shak-o-shubha karte rahe aur tumhein tumhari fazool tamannaon ne dhoke mein hi rakha yahaan tak ke Allah ka hukm aa pahuncha aur tumhein Allah ke baare mein dhoka dene wale ne dhoke mein hi rakha.
ayahs.15: Algharz, aaj tum se na fidya (aur na badla) qubool kiya jaayega aur na kaafiron se tum (sab) ka thikaana Dozakh hai. Wohi tumhari rafeeq hai aur woh bura thikaana hai.
ayahs.16: Kya ab tak imaan walon ke liye waqt nahi aaya ke un ke dil zikr-e-Ilahi se aur jo haq utar chuka hai us se narm ho jaayen aur un ki tarah na ho jaayen jinhein un se pehle kitaab di gayi thi phir jab un par ek zamana daraaz guzar gaya to un ke dil sakht ho gaye aur un mein bahut se faasiq hain.
ayahs.17: Yaqeen maano ke Allah hi zameen ko us ki maut ke baad zinda kar deta hai. Hum ne to tumhare liye apni aayatein bayaan kar dein taake tum samjho.
ayahs.18: Beshak sadqa dene wale mard aur sadqa dene wali auratein aur jo Allah ko khuloos ke saath qarz de rahe hain. Un ke liye yeh badhaaya jaayega aur un ke liye pasandeeda ajr-o-sawaab hai.
ayahs.19: Allah aur us ke Rasool par jo imaan rakhte hain wohi log apne Rabb ke nazdeek siddiq aur shaheed hain un ke liye un ka ajr aur un ka noor hai, aur jo log kufr karte hain aur hamari aayaton ko jhutlaate hain woh Jahannami hain.
ayahs.20: Khoob jaan rakho ke dunya ki zindagi sirf khel tamaasha zeenat aur aapas mein fakhr (o ghuroor) aur maal-o-aulaad mein ek ka doosre se apne aap ko ziyaada batlaana hai, jaise baarish aur us ki paidaawaar kisaanon ko achhi maaloom hoti hai phir jab woh khushk ho jaati hai to zard rang mein us ko tum dekhte ho phir woh bilkul choora choora ho jaati hai aur aakhirat mein sakht azaab aur Allah ki maghfirat aur razamandi hai aur dunya ki zindagi bajuz dhoke ke saamaan ke aur kuch bhi to nahi.
ayahs.21: (Aao) Daudo apne Rabb ki maghfirat ki taraf aur us jannat ki taraf jis ki wusat aasmaan-o-zameen ki wusat ke baraabar hai yeh un ke liye banaai hai jo Allah par aur us ke Rasoolon par imaan rakhte hain. Yeh Allah ka fazl hai jise chaahe de aur Allah bade fazl wala hai.
ayahs.22: Na koi museebat dunya mein aati hai na (khaas) tumhari jaanon mein, magar us se pehle ke hum us ko paida karen woh ek khaas kitaab mein likhi hui hai, yeh (kaam) Allah Taala par (bilkul) aasaan hai.
ayahs.23: Taake tum apne se faut-shuda kisi cheez par ranjida na ho jaaya karo aur na ata-karda cheez par itra jaao, aur itraane wale shekhi-khoron ko Allah pasand nahi farmaata.
ayahs.24: Jo (khud bhi) bukhl karen aur doosron ko (bhi) bukhl ki taaleem den. Suno! Jo bhi munh phere Allah be-niyaaz aur sazaawaar-e-hamd-o-sanaa hai.
ayahs.25: Yaqeenan hum ne apne paighambaron ko khuli daleelein de kar bheja aur un ke saath kitaab aur meezan (taraazu) naazil farmaaya taake log adl par qaayam rahein. Aur hum ne lohe ko utaara jis mein sakht haibat-o-quwwat hai aur logon ke liye aur bhi (bahut se) faaide hain aur is liye bhi ke Allah jaan le ke us ki aur us ke Rasoolon ki madad be-dekhe kaun karta hai, beshak Allah quwwat wala aur zabardast hai.
ayahs.26: Beshak hum ne Nooh aur Ibraheem (Alaihis-Salaam) ko (paighambar bana kar) bheja aur hum ne un dono ki aulaad mein paighambari aur kitaab jaari rakhi to un mein se kuch to raah-yafta hue aur un mein se aksar bahut naafarmaan rahe.
ayahs.27: Un ke baad phir bhi hum apne Rasoolon ko pe-dar-pe bhejte rahe aur un ke baad Eesa bin Maryam (Alaihis-Salaam) ko bheja aur unhein Injeel ata farmaai aur un ke maanne walon ke dilon mein shafqat aur reham paida kar diya haan rahbaniyat (tark-e-dunya) to un logon ne az-khud eejaad kar li thi hum ne un par ise waajib na kiya tha siwaaye Allah ki razajoi ke. So unhon ne us ki poori riayat na ki, phir bhi hum ne un mein se jo imaan laaye the. Unhein un ka ajr diya aur un mein ziyaada tar log naafarmaan hain.
ayahs.28: Ae woh logo jo imaan laaye ho! Allah se darte raha karo aur us ke Rasool par imaan laao Allah tumhein apni rehmat ka dohra hissa dega aur tumhein noor dega jis ki roshni mein tum chalo phiroge aur tumhare gunaah bhi maaf farma dega, Allah bakhshne wala meherbaan hai.
ayahs.29: Yeh is liye ke Ahl-e-Kitaab jaan len ke Allah ke fazl ke kisi hissa par bhi unhein ikhtiyaar nahi aur yeh ke (saara) fazl Allah hi ke haath hai woh jise chaahe de, aur Allah hai hi bade fazl wala.
